name: calendar-sync-app
description: Full-stack app that synchronizes Google Calendar and Microsoft Outlook events in real time, with a Node/Express backend and a React frontend.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"

author: Tanay Thatte
